notes: BottomUp is the base model forecast unchanged.
TopDown rescales all SKUs per day so the grand total matches the target.
MiddleOut rescales SKUs within each category per day to match category totals, preserving the model's in-category SKU shape.
target=blend mixes the corporate aggregate with the base model aggregate by blend-alpha; use it when corporate totals are directionally trustworthy but not fully.
